verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides (e.g., Box Notes, Office 365 Online, or Google Docs integration) — only vague marketing taglines like 'edit, and co-create content with AI' with no technical or feature-level detail, plus unrelated APIs for uploads, sharing, metadata, and AI extraction. No concrete evidence supports in-browser real-time collaborative editing.
